leiden-summer-school-languages-linguisti.about:
The Leiden Summer School in Languages and Linguistics is one of Europe's best-known summer programmes for linguistics and ancient languages. The 2027 edition runs Monday 5 to Friday 16 July 2027 in Leiden (Netherlands), with tracks in Anatolian, Classics, Descriptive Linguistics, Language Documentation, Eastern Christianity, Germanic, General Linguistics, Historical Linguistics, Indo-European, Indology, Iranian, Papyrology, Russian Literature, Semitic and Sino-Tibetan.

It is open to bachelor, master and PhD students. Courses are taught in English (Russian Literature in Russian) and most are hybrid, so you can also join online. Active participation earns 2 ECTS per course, plus 3 ECTS with an extra take-home assignment.

The full course list is published around February/March 2027, when registration opens; the deadline is 3 May 2027. It is a rare chance to learn rare languages from Leiden specialists alongside students from all over the world.
highlights: 15 thematic tracks from Sino-Tibetan to Papyrology
Hybrid: attend in Leiden or online
leiden-summer-school-languages-linguisti.eligibility: Bachelor, master and PhD students of any nationality interested in linguistics or ancient languages. Courses are in English (one in Russian).
how_to_apply: Check the 2027 course programme when it is published (February/March 2027).
Choose your courses and on-campus or online format.
Register online before 3 May 2027.
Pay the course fee (non-refundable).
leiden-summer-school-languages-linguisti.costs: Fee for 2027 to be announced (non-refundable); Leiden students get a discount. Travel and accommodation are not included.

lille-european-summer-program-2027.about:
The LILLE European Summer Program (ESP) is the Catholic University of Lille's month-long summer study programme in northern France. Students choose electives in English or French across Liberal Arts, Business & Communication, Health, European Studies, Sustainability & the Sciences and French Language, earning at least 12 ECTS (6 US credits). A separate LiDD Design Summer Camp track is also offered.

Two sessions run in 2027: ESP1 from 19 May to 18 June and ESP2 from 22 June to 21 July. The package includes accommodation, meal and transport passes, and included visits in France and Belgium.

Registration opens in early February 2027 and is first-come, first-served, with priority for partner-university students.
lille-european-summer-program-2027.eligibility: University students; partner-university students have priority, others may be waitlisted. See the FAQ for language and academic requirements.
how_to_apply: Check with your home university about credit transfer.
Apply online when registration opens in early February 2027.
Choose your session and courses.
Pay the programme cost to secure your place.
lille-european-summer-program-2027.costs: Programme cost covers administration, tuition and hospitality (accommodation, meal and transport passes); see the official Cost page.

lille-winter-program-2027.about:
LILLE Winter is a short credit-bearing programme in Lille, France, from 6 to 23 January 2027. Students take one morning course (French Language and Culture, or Project Management in Europe) and one afternoon course (French Art and Cinema, World-Class Art Museums, Making the Most of Diverse Teams, or Sustainability in Action), plus an intercultural communication session, for 8 ECTS in total.

It suits university students who want a European study experience during their winter break. The cost covers administration, tuition and hospitality.

Registration opened 1 September 2026; application and payment must be completed by 15 November 2026, and places go first come, first served.
highlights: French language or European project management
lille-winter-program-2027.eligibility: University students; check additional requirements with your home study-abroad office.
how_to_apply: Pick your morning and afternoon courses.
Apply online via the Lille application platform.
Pay the programme cost by 15 November 2026.
lille-winter-program-2027.costs: Programme cost (on the official Cost page) covers administration, tuition and hospitality.

liverpool-international-summer-school-20.about:
The University of Liverpool International Summer School offers short, credit-bearing academic modules that complement your home degree, plus an English Communication Skills pathway, in the Russell Group university's city-centre campus. A social programme explores Liverpool's culture, and students live in city-centre residences.

It is open to current undergraduate and postgraduate students and recent graduates worldwide aged 18+. Academic modules need IELTS 6.0 (B2) unless your university teaches in English; the English pathway needs IELTS 5.0 (B1). After paying you receive a confirmation for a UK visitor visa, with a refund if the visa is refused.

Applications for Summer 2027 are due to open soon (the 2026 deadline was 1 May); email iss@liverpool.ac.uk to register interest.
highlights: English skills pathway for B1 learners
liverpool-international-summer-school-20.eligibility: Current undergraduate/postgraduate students or graduates of any university, aged 18+; IELTS 6.0 for academic modules (5.0 for the English pathway) unless taught in English.
how_to_apply: Register interest at iss@liverpool.ac.uk.
Apply online when Summer 2027 applications open.
Pay tuition and accommodation.
Use the confirmation letter for a UK visitor visa if needed.
liverpool-international-summer-school-20.costs: 2027 fees on the 'Dates and fees' page when published; discounts for Liverpool/XJTLU students. Accommodation optional.

lorraine-french-horizons-bootcamp-2027.about:
The French Horizons Bootcamp is a ten-day summer lab run by the Université de Lorraine at its Charly Lab fab lab in Nancy, 14–25 June 2027. Teams design a game that can be played inside a museum and is accessible to everyone, using 3D scanning and printing, laser cutting, augmented and virtual reality and graphic design tools.

Visits include the Musée de l'École de Nancy and the Centre Pompidou-Metz, with excursions to Metz and the Vosges mountains. Completion earns 3 ECTS and a certificate.

It is open to all students, taught in English, with no prior technical knowledge needed. Registration for 2027 is open now.
highlights: Hands-on fab lab: 3D printing, laser cutting, AR/VR
lorraine-french-horizons-bootcamp-2027.eligibility: All university students; taught in English; no special prior knowledge required.
how_to_apply: Read the bootcamp site.
Register via the 'Fees/Register for the bootcamp' page.
Pay the fee.
Check credit recognition with your home university.

lumc-population-health-management-summer.about:
This LUMC summer school introduces the fundamentals of Population Health Management: how health systems respond to ageing populations, epidemiological challenges, rising healthcare costs and new medical technology. Participants work on practical cases.

The 2027 edition starts 5 July 2027 and runs five days at the Health Campus The Hague. It is aimed at master's students, PhD candidates and professionals working in or around healthcare.

The big draw is the price: master's students in health-related studies attend free. Registration is via the official 2027 form.
lumc-population-health-management-summer.eligibility: Master's students, PhD candidates and professionals in health and healthcare; any nationality; English.
how_to_apply: Read the 2027 programme page.
Fill in the PHM Summer School 2027 registration form.
Ask LUMC-CampusDenHaag@lumc.nl about the deadline and payment.
lumc-population-health-management-summer.costs: Free for master's students in health-related studies; PhD candidates €375; professionals €950.

magec-casc-2026.about:
MAGEC (Mid-American Global Education Center) has run Michigan's Model UN circuit for decades, with conferences for high-school and middle-school delegations. CASC is a two-day conference with several Security Councils running at once, plus bodies such as the African Union, EU, OAS, Arab League, NATO, ASEAN and ECOSOC.

The conference runs 4–5 December 2026 at Lansing, Michigan, United States. It is open to high school students and school delegations (Michigan, Ontario and beyond). Working language: English.

Schools register via 'Registration & Fees' on the MAGEC site; see 'Dates & Deadlines'. The delegate fee is published on the official registration page. As at any MUN, delegates research their assigned country, write position papers, give speeches, negotiate in caucuses and draft resolutions — hands-on training in public speaking, research and diplomacy that universities value.
highlights: Multiple Security Councils plus AU, EU, NATO, ASEAN
The delegate fee is published on the official registration page
magec-casc-2026.eligibility: Open to high school students and school delegations (Michigan, Ontario and beyond). Working language: English. No nationality restrictions are stated; international delegates (including from Georgia and Qatar) can apply, arranging their own visa and travel.
how_to_apply: Open the official website (link below) and read the conference information and committee list.
Schools register via 'Registration & Fees' on the MAGEC site; see 'Dates & Deadlines'.
Pay the delegate fee by the stated deadline to confirm your place.
Prepare a position paper using the committee study guides before the conference.
magec-casc-2026.costs: The delegate fee is published on the official registration page. Travel, accommodation and visas are paid by participants unless stated otherwise.

MAGEC (Mid-American Global Education Center) has run Michigan's Model UN circuit for decades, with conferences for high-school and middle-school delegations. CASC Jr. is a one-day junior edition with General Assembly-style committees, designed for future Model UN students in grades 7–8.

The conference runs 3 December 2026 at Lansing, Michigan, United States. It is open to middle school students in grades 7–8. Working language: English.

Schools register via 'Registration & Fees' on the MAGEC site. The delegate fee is published on the official registration page. As at any MUN, delegates research their assigned country, write position papers, give speeches, negotiate in caucuses and draft resolutions — hands-on training in public speaking, research and diplomacy that universities value.

magec-mahsc-2027.about:
MAGEC (Mid-American Global Education Center) has run Michigan's Model UN circuit for decades, with conferences for high-school and middle-school delegations. MAHSC takes delegates back in time to re-debate crises the real Security Council already decided, representing the countries that sat on the Council at the time.

The conference runs 24–25 April 2027 at Dexter, Michigan, United States. It is open to high school students. Working language: English.

Schools register via the MAHSC 'Registration' page on the MAGEC site. The delegate fee is published on the official registration page. As at any MUN, delegates research their assigned country, write position papers, give speeches, negotiate in caucuses and draft resolutions — hands-on training in public speaking, research and diplomacy that universities value.

mamun-2027.about:
MAGEC (Mid-American Global Education Center) has run Michigan's Model UN circuit for decades, with conferences for high-school and middle-school delegations. MAMUN is its flagship three-and-a-half-day spring conference, with five General Assembly committees, a conference-long Security Council and ad hoc crisis committees.

The conference runs 3–6 March 2027 at Grand Rapids, Michigan, United States. It is open to high school students of all experience levels. Working language: English.

Schools register via 'Registration & Fees' (MAMUN section) on the MAGEC site. The delegate fee is published on the official registration page. As at any MUN, delegates research their assigned country, write position papers, give speeches, negotiate in caucuses and draft resolutions — hands-on training in public speaking, research and diplomacy that universities value.

meiji-short-term-japanese-program-winter.about:
Meiji University's Short-Term Japanese Language Program (winter 2027) runs 1–12 February 2027 in Tokyo. It offers elementary (JLPT N4 / CEFR A2) and intermediate (N3–N2 / B1) classes, with placement by online test, plus a bus tour and field trips.

It is open to undergraduate and graduate students living outside Japan and enrolled at an overseas university; partner-institution students have priority and visa support. Partner students meeting JASSO's criteria can receive ¥80,000 after completing the programme.

The fee is ¥90,000 (tuition, textbooks, tours). Apply by 5 November 2026; applications may close early.
highlights: JASSO ¥80,000 grant for eligible partner students
meiji-short-term-japanese-program-winter.eligibility: Undergraduate/graduate students enrolled at an overseas university and living outside Japan; JLPT N4–N2 level (no complete beginners or advanced learners); first-time participants only.
how_to_apply: Fill in the online application form by 5 November 2026.
Take the online placement test.
Pay the fee after acceptance.
Arrange accommodation and visa (visa support for partner students only).
meiji-short-term-japanese-program-winter.costs: ¥90,000 (tuition, textbooks, bus tour, field trips). Accommodation, travel and meals extra. JASSO scholarship ¥80,000 for eligible partner students.

meta-vr-start-developer-competition-2026.about:
Meta's VR Start Developer Competition challenges members of the Meta VR Start programme to build hands-first experiences for Meta Quest and Meta VR glasses in three tracks: Entertainment, Gaming and Productivity. Entrants can use Unity, Unreal, Android or the Immersive Web SDK, with mentor programming and workshops along the way.

Submissions close on 18 November 2026. The prize pool is USD 1 million, with top prizes of USD 100,000. Joining the Start programme takes about five minutes. Best suited to university students and developers with some game-engine experience.
highlights: USD 1M prize pool, top prizes USD 100,000
meta-vr-start-developer-competition-2026.eligibility: Members of the Meta VR Start programme who meet the official rules (age of majority; some countries excluded). Check the Rules tab before entering.
how_to_apply: Register on the official Devpost page
Join the organisers' Discord/discussion board to find teammates
Build your project during the hacking period
Submit code, demo video and description before the deadline
meta-vr-start-developer-competition-2026.costs: Free to enter; a Meta Quest device is helpful for testing.

mis-mun-almaty-2027.about:
MIS MUN is the annual Model United Nations conference of Miras International School in Almaty, held for 22 years. The 2026 edition took place offline on 19-20 February 2026, with registration from 21 November 2025 to 21 January 2026; the 2027 edition is expected to follow the same pattern.

Participants are students in grades 9-12, with 5-7 delegates per school plus teachers or advisors. The fee covers a delegate package, transport, breakfast, lunch, coffee breaks and a diplomatic buffet, and delegates receive a certificate. It is an affordable way for school MUN clubs from the Caucasus to experience a Central Asian conference.
highlights: Low fee including meals and local transport
mis-mun-almaty-2027.eligibility: High school students in grades 9-12, registered as a school delegation of 5-7 delegates with a teacher/advisor; international schools welcome.
how_to_apply: Check mismun.miras.kz for the 2027 announcement (registration opened in late November last cycle).
Form a school delegation of 5-7 students with an advisor.
Register before the deadline (21 January in the last cycle).
Pay the delegate fee and arrange travel to Almaty.
mis-mun-almaty-2027.costs: 2026 delegate fee: KZT 30,000 (delegate package, transport, meals, diplomatic buffet). Travel and accommodation extra.

mit-battlecode-2027.about:
Battlecode is a real-time strategy game for which teams write an autonomous program: two teams of virtual robots manage resources and execute offensive strategies against each other, and your code must coordinate the whole army. It is run by MIT students and has been a famous MIT programming tradition for decades.

The competition takes place throughout January, with lectures, sprint tournaments and qualifying tournaments online, ending in a final tournament. Anyone may participate and any team can win the sprint prizes; the main prizes are for student teams, including non-MIT and high-school teams (Battlecode 2026 paid out over USD 20,000 in prizes, with dedicated high-school awards).
mit-battlecode-2027.eligibility: Anyone can participate; prize eligibility for the main tournament is limited to student teams (see the full eligibility rules on the site).
how_to_apply: Join the Battlecode mailing list on battlecode.org
Register a team (1–4 people) when 2027 registration opens
Follow the January lectures and download the game engine
Submit bots for the sprint and qualifying tournaments

mlh-global-hack-week-builders-nov-2026.about:
Global Hack Week (GHW) is Major League Hacking's monthly online event where students and new developers learn skills, build portfolio projects and connect with the MLH community. Builders Week (6–12 November 2026) is aimed at beginners: live streams and workshops, small daily challenges and a Discord community to get help.

It is 100% free and open to anyone, anywhere. Completing challenges earns badges and points, and it is a low-pressure way to get ready for full hackathons.
highlights: Live sessions, daily challenges, Discord community
Earn MLH badges and build portfolio projects
mlh-global-hack-week-builders-nov-2026.eligibility: Free for anyone, anywhere. MLH events generally require participants to be 13+ and to follow the MLH Code of Conduct.
how_to_apply: Open ghw.mlh.com and choose the week
Register for free with an MLH account
Join the MLH Discord
Attend live sessions and complete challenges during the week

mlh-global-hack-week-open-source-dec-202.about:
Open Source Week (4–10 December 2026) is a Global Hack Week edition from Major League Hacking dedicated to open source. Participants join live sessions on how open-source projects work, make first contributions (issues, pull requests, documentation) and complete daily challenges with help from the MLH Discord.

It is free and open to anyone, anywhere, and is a useful stepping stone towards programmes like Google Summer of Code, Outreachy or the MLH Fellowship.
highlights: Live sessions, daily challenges, Discord community
Earn MLH badges and build portfolio projects
mlh-global-hack-week-open-source-dec-202.eligibility: Free for anyone, anywhere. MLH events generally require participants to be 13+ and to follow the MLH Code of Conduct.
how_to_apply: Open ghw.mlh.com and choose the week
Register for free with an MLH account
Join the MLH Discord
Attend live sessions and complete challenges during the week

mmun-67-2027.about:
Midwest Model United Nations is one of the oldest collegiate MUNs in the United States, now in its 67th session, designed for students new to Model UN as well as experienced delegates. Background guides for the GA First Committee and other bodies are published on the site.

The conference runs 17–20 February 2027 at a conference hotel in St. Louis (see the Hotel Info page), United States. It is open to college and university students, both new and returning delegates. Working language: English.

Register on the official Registration page (mmun.org/registration/). The delegate fee is published on the official registration page. As at any MUN, delegates research their assigned country, write position papers, give speeches, negotiate in caucuses and draft resolutions — hands-on training in public speaking, research and diplomacy that universities value.
highlights: 17–20 February 2027 in St. Louis, United States
The delegate fee is published on the official registration page

Register on the official Registration page (mmun.org/registration/).
Pay the delegate fee by the stated deadline to confirm your place.
Prepare a position paper using the committee study guides before the conference.
mmun-67-2027.costs: The delegate fee is published on the official registration page. Travel, accommodation and visas are paid by participants unless stated otherwise.

mostratec-2027.about:
MOSTRATEC (Mostra Internacional de Ciência e Tecnologia) is organised by the Liberato technical school foundation and is a well-known international science fair for school students, from early grades to upper secondary and technical secondary school. Projects are judged by scientists; top projects earn awards and places at other international fairs. MOSTRATEC Júnior runs alongside for younger students.

Projects reach MOSTRATEC either through affiliated science fairs (affiliation window 1–31 May in 2026) or by direct online submission in the selection process (1–31 July in 2026). The 2026 fair (41st edition) hosted students from 13 countries in late October at FENAC in Novo Hamburgo. Expect the 2027 edition to follow the same calendar; check the official schedule (cronograma) and research rules before starting a project.
highlights: Latin America's biggest international school science fair
Direct online project submission or entry via affiliated fairs
Awards include places at other international fairs
mostratec-2027.eligibility: School students (infant, primary, secondary and technical secondary) with a research project, from Brazil or abroad; follow MOSTRATEC's research rules and age categories.
how_to_apply: Read MOSTRATEC's regulations and scientific research rules
Do your project with a teacher advisor following the rules
Submit the project in the July selection window, or qualify through an affiliated fair
If accepted, register the team and travel to Novo Hamburgo in late October 2027
mostratec-2027.costs: Registration fees and travel costs apply; check the official regulations. Some affiliated fairs offer support for winners.

msumun-xxvi-2027.about:
MSUMUN is Michigan State University's high-school Model UN, now in its 26th session, held in the Michigan State Union, with crisis, historical and fictional committees plus outreach scholarships.

The conference runs 19–21 March 2027 at the Michigan State Union, East Lansing, United States. It is open to high school students and school delegations; first-time schools welcome. Working language: English.

Registration is now open; advisors should see the 'Advisors' tab on the official site. The delegate fee is published on the official registration page. Scholarships/outreach support are available. As at any MUN, delegates research their assigned country, write position papers, give speeches, negotiate in caucuses and draft resolutions — hands-on training in public speaking, research and diplomacy that universities value.

munglobal-tr-senior-2026.about:
MUNGLOBAL TR Senior Edition takes place on 5-8 December 2026 at Belek Beach Resort Hotel near Antalya. Organised by Oxford Corridor and endorsed by Midland Schools for Innovative Learning (UK), it runs committees such as UN Women, UNOOSA, UNDRR, ECOFIN, UNESCO, ILO, Legal and the Security Council.

The package fee includes airport pick-up and drop-off, a 5-star hotel (triple rooms by default), all meals, conference materials, a welcome pack, social and cultural night and MUN training led by a former UN diplomat. Best delegates win a fully funded place at the next edition. It suits delegations from schools and universities who want a structured, all-inclusive trip.
highlights: All-inclusive: hotel, meals and airport transfers
Training session with a former UN diplomat
Best delegates win a funded place at the next edition
munglobal-tr-senior-2026.eligibility: High school and university students from any country, usually registered as a school delegation with a faculty advisor; individuals can also apply.
how_to_apply: Open the MUNGLOBAL TR Senior page on oxfordcorridor.com.
Choose a payment plan (early, regular or late) and click Apply.
Register your delegation or yourself and choose committee preferences.
Pay the package fee (no refunds) and book flights to Antalya.
munglobal-tr-senior-2026.costs: Package price shown on the organiser page (late plan about EUR 540); includes accommodation, meals, transfers and materials. Flights are extra. Strict no-refund policy.

munol-2027.about:
MUNOL is a five-day international school conference in the Hanseatic city of Lübeck, run by the non-profit MUNOL e.V., which arranges host-family accommodation (Gastfamilien) for visiting delegates.

The conference runs 10–14 May 2027 at venues in Lübeck, Germany. It is open to secondary school students from Germany and abroad. Working language: English.

ntu-pace-driving-digital-innovation-2027.about:
Driving Digital Innovation is a short student immersion programme by NTU's College of Professional and Continuing Education (PACE). NTU professors cover digital disruption, big data, AI (including generative and agentic AI), predictive analytics, blockchain and digital assets. Teams analyse a real organisation's digital strategy and present their findings.

The week includes NTU campus tours with student ambassadors, research-facility visits such as the Singapore Centre for 3D Printing, and an industry visit. Two runs in 2027: 25–29 January and 2–6 August.

It is for undergraduates of any major. January run: register by 30 November 2026; August run: registration opens 4 January 2027 and closes 7 June 2027.
highlights: Generative and agentic AI, blockchain, analytics
ntu-pace-driving-digital-innovation-2027.eligibility: Undergraduate students of any nationality and major.
how_to_apply: Choose the January or August 2027 run.
Register online via the NTU course portal and pay the S$19.62 application fee.
January run: register by 30 Nov 2026 and pay by 4 Dec 2026.
August run: register 4 Jan – 7 Jun 2027.
ntu-pace-driving-digital-innovation-2027.costs: S$3,106.50 (incl. GST); group rates S$2,943 (3+ students) or S$2,834 (9+). Application fee S$19.62. Self-funded; no scholarships. Travel and accommodation extra.

ntu-taiwan-spring-plus-chinese-2027.about:
NTU Plus Academy's Spring+ Chinese Language & Culture Program runs 2–24 March 2027 at National Taiwan University in Taipei, Taiwan's top university. Students take about three hours of Mandarin a day (listening, speaking, reading, writing), practise with local NTU students at the Tutor Station, and join the English-taught Exploring Taiwan course on history, society, art, music, food and Indigenous heritage, with field trips and a one-day excursion.

It is open to anyone aged 16 or older (so final-year high-school students can join) who is not a native Chinese speaker; intermediate English (around TOEIC 600) is recommended but no test is required. Completion earns a certificate and a transcript with 3 NTU credits.

Apply online 12 October 2026 – 12 January 2027; pay within five working days of acceptance. Optional co-living housing costs about USD 600–800.
highlights: Daily Mandarin plus tutor sessions with NTU students
ntu-taiwan-spring-plus-chinese-2027.eligibility: Aged 16+; not a native Chinese speaker; intermediate English recommended (no test needed). One programme per spring session.
how_to_apply: Create an account on the NTU short-term programme system.
Apply between 12 October 2026 and 12 January 2027 and pay the USD 200 fee.
Pay the programme fee within 5 working days of acceptance.
Book optional housing early (limited).
ntu-taiwan-spring-plus-chinese-2027.costs: USD 200 non-refundable application fee; programme fee (shown on the official page) covers tuition, orientation, cultural courses, activities and accident insurance. Accommodation not included; optional housing about USD 600–800.

ntu-taiwan-spring-plus-research-culture-.about:
The Spring+ Research & Culture Program lets international students work with National Taiwan University faculty in labs or on research projects across many colleges, from 22 February to 26 March 2027. Alongside research, the English-taught Exploring Taiwan course covers history, arts, food and Indigenous heritage, with site visits and a one-day trip.

It is open to undergraduate and graduate students enrolled at a university outside Taiwan with a GPA of at least 2.7/4.3; first- and second-year students need approval from their chosen NTU professor. Completion earns 4 NTU credits.

Apply 12 October 2026 – 12 January 2027. Optional housing costs about USD 900–1,150.

NTU Summer+ Chinese Language & Culture runs 21 June – 30 July 2027 at National Taiwan University in Taipei. Students take an intensive Mandarin course (5 credits) and the English-taught Exploring Taiwan course (2 credits) on history, society, art, food and Indigenous culture, with field trips.

It is open to anyone aged 16 or older who is not a native Chinese speaker; intermediate English is recommended. The NTU Huayu BEST Program offers scholarships to students from certain US and European partner universities.

Summer+ Intensive Research is National Taiwan University's longest summer research option: eight weeks (21 June – 13 August 2027) working full-time with an NTU professor in a lab or research project. Supervisors are chosen from the 2027 faculty list on the NTU system.

nu-ssres-summer-school-2027.about:
SSRES (Summer School in Russian and Eurasian Studies) is an academic programme of Nazarbayev University's School of Sciences and Humanities. It provides immersive study of Russian and Kazakh languages while exploring Kazakh and post-Soviet culture, with classes and cultural activities in Astana.

NU summer schools usually run between mid-June and mid-August, and calls are announced by the schools or the Department of International Cooperation two to three months before the start. It suits university students of languages, area studies, international relations or history who want to study in Central Asia.
highlights: Courses on Kazakh and post-Soviet culture
Hosted by Central Asia's top research university

Pay programme fees and obtain a visa if required.
nu-ssres-summer-school-2027.costs: Programme fees set in the annual call; travel and accommodation as specified by NU.

nu-summer-camp-2027.about:
NU Summer Camp is Nazarbayev University's two-week immersive programme introducing school students aged 14-18 to university-level learning and student life. In 2026 it offered five tracks (Natural Sciences; Medicine and Biomechanics; Social Sciences and Humanities; Engineering and Innovation; Artificial Intelligence and Robotics) in four sessions between 3 June and 25 July.

Under faculty and mentors, participants combine academic classes, laboratory work and personal development, helping them choose a future field of study. NU teaches in English and is Central Asia's leading research university, so the camp also works as a preview for students considering NU's international undergraduate admission.
highlights: Five academic tracks including AI and medicine
Lab work with NU faculty in English
Two-week sessions across June and July

Complete pre-registration and the application.
Pay the fee if required and arrange travel to Astana.
nu-summer-camp-2027.costs: Fees are set in the annual call; travel to Astana extra.

nyas-junior-academy-2027.about:
The Junior Academy is the New York Academy of Sciences' signature high-school programme. Accepted students join Launchpad, an online platform where they form international teams and work on Innovation Challenges sponsored by companies, guided by STEM mentors. Each challenge starts with a kick-off week on research methods, design thinking and data analysis.

Challenges start every September and February and need about 3–4 hours a week. Ten projects of distinction go to external judges, and winning teams are recognised by the Academy. Once accepted, students stay in the community and do not need to reapply the following year.

It is completely free, fully online and in English, and admission is selective (thousands apply from all over the world). A strong application in English is essential.
highlights: Real industry-sponsored STEM challenges with mentors
nyas-junior-academy-2027.eligibility: Students aged 13–17 anywhere in the world with strong English (assessed in the application). No citizenship restriction is stated.

Wait for the decision (August or January, depending on the cycle)
Join Launchpad and pick a challenge when it opens

ocad-u-pre-university-summer-intensive-2.about:
The OCAD U Pre-University Summer Intensive is a three-week, weekday studio programme in downtown Toronto for teenagers considering art or design at university. Students work with OCAD U faculty on drawing and studio projects, build portfolio pieces and get a feel for art-school life.

The 2027 edition is open to local, out-of-province and international high-school students who have completed grade 10 and will be 16 by July 2027. Applications open in January 2027; OCAD U runs a notification list for the exact opening date. Housing is not described on the page, so international students should plan their own accommodation in Toronto.
highlights: Studio work with OCAD U faculty in downtown Toronto
Portfolio-building for art and design admission
ocad-u-pre-university-summer-intensive-2.eligibility: High-school students who have completed grade 10 and will be at least 16 by July 2027; local, out-of-province and international students are eligible.

Arrange your own accommodation and any Canadian visa or eTA

odyssey-of-the-mind-world-finals-2027.about:
Odyssey of the Mind teams work for months on an open-ended 'long-term problem' — building vehicles, structures or theatrical performances — under strict rules and budgets, then present it at tournaments alongside a spontaneous problem solved on the day. Teams advance through regional and state/national association competitions to World Finals.

The programme is international, with associations in many countries; schools purchase a membership to access the 2026–27 problems.

odyssey-of-the-mind-world-finals-2027.eligibility: Teams from schools or organisations with an Odyssey of the Mind membership, competing in age divisions from primary to college, through their regional/national association.

Compete at your regional/association tournament
Qualify for World Finals

olmun-2027.about:
OLMUN has offered students from around the world an international UN simulation in Oldenburg, northern Germany, for more than 20 years, run by the non-profit Oldenburg Model United Nations e.V.

The conference runs 15–18 June 2027 at venues in Oldenburg, Germany. It is open to secondary school students from around the world. Working language: English.

Applications open on 31 Dec 2026 on the official site. The delegate fee is published on the official registration page. As at any MUN, delegates research their assigned country, write position papers, give speeches, negotiate in caucuses and draft resolutions — hands-on training in public speaking, research and diplomacy that universities value.

opwall-honduras-expeditions-2027.about:
Operation Wallacea (Opwall) runs biodiversity and conservation research expeditions in which school and university students work as field assistants alongside academic scientists, collecting data that is used to protect the sites. In Honduras the expeditions are based at the cloud forests of Cusuco National Park (Base Camp, Buenos Aires and satellite camps) and Caribbean reefs around Utila in the Bay Islands and Tela. Research focuses on cloud-forest carbon stocks, fungi, moths, birds, reptiles, amphibians and bats, and Caribbean reef health, invasive lionfish and urchin recovery.

There are three ways to join: two-week school expeditions for high-school/sixth-form students (with training lectures and a guided research programme), research-assistant expeditions of 2–6 weeks for university students and graduates, and six-week thesis expeditions where undergraduates collect data for a dissertation. Thesis expeditions run 16 June–27 July 2027; a separate 2-week Bay Islands marine school expedition is also offered. Students from any country can book directly with Opwall or through national offices; most raise the cost through fundraising.
highlights: Real field research with academic scientists
Data used for conservation management of the sites
opwall-honduras-expeditions-2027.eligibility: High-school students (school expeditions, typically 16+) and university students/graduates (research-assistant and thesis expeditions), from any country. Good health and travel insurance required.
how_to_apply: Choose school, research-assistant or thesis expedition and the site
Book online on the Opwall booking page and pay the deposit
Plan fundraising and pay the balance by the date in your booking
Complete medical, kit and travel preparations from Opwall's guidance

School expeditions: 2 weeks from GBP 1,800 (USD 2,375); price varies with departure country, group size and whether flights are included. Most participants fundraise.

In Madagascar the expeditions are based at Mariarano in the Mahamavo dry forests of north-west Madagascar, the lakeside satellite camp Matsedroy, Antafiameva, and a marine site at Ambondrona on Nosy Be island. Research focuses on lemurs and other primates, birds, reptiles, botany and largely unstudied Indo-Pacific coral reefs in a country where about 90% of species are endemic.

There are three ways to join: two-week school expeditions for high-school/sixth-form students (with training lectures and a guided research programme), research-assistant expeditions of 2–6 weeks for university students and graduates, and six-week thesis expeditions where undergraduates collect data for a dissertation. Thesis expeditions run 17 June–29 July 2027. Students from any country can book directly with Opwall or through national offices; most raise the cost through fundraising.

Research focuses on jungle mammals including big cats and primates, bats, reptiles and butterflies, and on the coast green turtles, seagrass and coral-reef restoration.

Oregon Model United Nations is a long-running, student-run state conference that also runs WinterCon/CrisisCon, the Nobel Peace Laureate Project and award scholarships.

oslo-international-summer-school-2027.about:
The University of Oslo's International Summer School (ISS), celebrating 80 years, brings students from around the world to Oslo for three- and four-week bachelor's and master's-level courses starting 28 June 2027 and six-week Norwegian language courses starting 21 June 2027. Courses carry credits and ISS housing includes a room, meals, an Oslo travel card and a social programme.

ISS offers scholarships for master's-level courses, chosen on academic and professional achievement, financial need, geographical distribution and diversity. A Basic Fee Scholarship covers tuition and the participation fee; an ISS Accommodation Scholarship also covers shared housing, meals and an Oslo travel card. Citizens of EU/EEA/Switzerland, US and Canadian citizens (who have separate schemes), bachelor's and Norwegian-course applicants and former recipients are not eligible for the general scholarships, so it suits students from countries such as Georgia or Qatar.
highlights: Credit courses at bachelor's and master's level in Oslo
Scholarships covering tuition, housing, meals and local travel
oslo-international-summer-school-2027.eligibility: University students meeting the course's academic requirements and English proficiency; scholarships only for master's-level course applicants who are not EU/EEA/Swiss, US or Canadian citizens or Norwegian residents. All other nationalities can apply.
how_to_apply: Pick up to two 2027 summer courses on the ISS course list
Apply in Søknadsweb from 4 January 2027 and tick the 'stipend' option for a scholarship
Upload the scholarship form, CV, recommendation letter, transcripts and English proof by 25 January 2027
Self-financed applicants apply by 1 March 2027
oslo-international-summer-school-2027.costs: 2026 fees for non-EU/EEA students: tuition NOK 15,800–21,900, participation fee NOK 3,100, ISS housing (room, meals, travel card) NOK 27,300; 2027 fees to be updated. Scholarships cover tuition and participation fee, optionally housing; travel to Oslo not covered.

padova-summer-schools-high-school-2027.about:
The University of Padua, founded in 1222, runs English-taught summer schools for high-school students in July 2027. Each module lasts one week and you can take one or two weeks. 2027 modules: Learning to Talk to Machines (prompt engineering and reasoning with LLMs, 12–18 July), Robotics and Automation, Innovating Medicine (from biology to digital healthcare), One Earth One Health, Psychologists: the Astronauts of Subjective Worlds, Economic and Managerial Decisions in Daily Life, and Markets, Competition and Cooperation.

It is for students aged 16–19 in the last two years of secondary school or recently graduated. The fee (€500 per week, €900 for two) covers all activities including guided tours; accommodation and meals are extra.

Applications open 16 November 2026 and close 16 March 2027 on apply.unipd.it.
highlights: Modules in AI, robotics, medicine, psychology, economics
padova-summer-schools-high-school-2027.eligibility: Students aged 16–19 enrolled in the last two years of high school or recently graduated; any nationality; English.
how_to_apply: Choose one or two weekly modules on the Padua summer schools page.
Apply on apply.unipd.it between 16 Nov 2026 and 16 Mar 2027.
Pay the fee after admission.
Book your own accommodation in Padua.
padova-summer-schools-high-school-2027.costs: €500 for one week, €900 for two weeks (activities and guided tours). Accommodation and meals not included.

pecs-summer-school-2027.about:
The University of Pécs, Hungary's oldest university, runs a set of two-week open summer schools from 4 to 17 July 2027 in the city of Pécs, southern Hungary. The 2027 programmes are AI and Data Management, European Studies, International Human Rights Law, Sustainability – Social Ecology, African Migrations Today (focus on Central and Eastern Europe) and Leadership Skills.

All are listed as open programmes available to all students and give transferable credits. Living costs in Pécs are low, which makes it one of the more affordable European summer schools. A European Studies Winter School also runs 17–30 January 2027.

Fees and deadlines are published on each programme page; contact summerschoolpecs@pte.hu for details.

peking-university-summer-school-internat.about:
Peking University Summer School International (PKUSSI), which held its 18th edition in 2026, brings university students from around the world to PKU's Beijing campus each July. Students choose courses taught in English by PKU faculty, for up to 6 PKU credits, in Session A, Session B (two weeks each) or both (four weeks); in 2026 these ran 6–17 July and 20–31 July.

Applicants must be 18–40, currently at college or university, and submit a transcript, an English personal statement and proof of English. Admission is competitive and based on overall performance. Applications open around New Year on PKU's online system (studyatpku.com), with a cheaper early-bird rate for those who pay by the end of March.
highlights: Courses taught by Peking University faculty
Up to 6 PKU credits in 2 or 4 weeks
peking-university-summer-school-internat.eligibility: Aged 18–40, currently enrolled at a college or university, with good academic records and English proficiency (TOEFL/IELTS/GRE as reference) for non-native speakers. All nationalities.

Upload passport page, stamped transcript, English personal statement and English proof
Pay the RMB 400 application fee
Pay tuition by 31 March for the early-bird rate; final deadline 31 May (2026 pattern)
peking-university-summer-school-internat.costs: 2026: application fee RMB 400; tuition RMB 15,000 (up to 4 credits) or 17,000 (5–6 credits) early bird, RMB 16,000/18,000 regular. Accommodation, travel and insurance extra.

polyphony-lit-winter-editing-apprentices.about:
Polyphony Lit is a global online literary magazine run for and by high-school students. Its Winter Editing Apprenticeship trains rising 9th–12th graders in the craft of literary editing through asynchronous modules, live lectures at 7 pm ET (recorded), group discussions and weekly assignments commenting on real author submissions in Submittable, with feedback from teaching assistants.

The winter session runs 27 December 2026 – 16 January 2027 (about 3–5 hours a week) and includes a Q&A with an outside editor and an optional one-to-one mentoring session with a poet. Students who register by 1 December 2026 can choose a bonus (free writing feedback or a mentoring session, limited places). Graduates can go on to join Polyphony's editorial staff. International students are welcome.
highlights: Edit real submissions to a global teen magazine
polyphony-lit-winter-editing-apprentices.eligibility: Rising 9th–12th grade (high-school) students worldwide with good English.
how_to_apply: Open the Winter Editing Apprenticeship page
Choose a sliding-scale registration option
Register (by 1 Dec 2026 for bonus offers)
Join the online course from 27 Dec 2026
polyphony-lit-winter-editing-apprentices.costs: Paid course with sliding-scale pricing (a 'supporter' rate subsidises students who cannot afford the full cost).

prague-summer-schools-2027.about:
Prague Summer Schools are one-week interdisciplinary schools for university students, run by the Prague-based NGO Schola Empirica. In 2027 four parallel schools run from 3 to 10 July: Behavioral Economics & Psychology; Development, Sustainability & Globalization; Education: The Future of School; and Crime, Law & Psychology.
